- DRAW / SELECT / ERASE / UNDO / REDO, the bars arrows, STOP / PLAY / REC, BPM / BARS / MAIN A chips, the gear, the cloud, SNAP, the GENERAL / GENERATE / MIDI headers, Generate / Clear, the pads switch, Drum Track, and the PATTERN / KIT arrows and chips all press in and spring back, and light up when they're on (DRAW green, PLAY green, REC red, Drum Track red while recording).
- Menus open on the button you tapped and close with an animation.
- The grid opens blank with every other beat darker grey; a pressed step lights its inner slot in the faceplate's colour (MODERN red, VINTAGE cream, TEXTURE blue).
- Space bar on a hardware keyboard starts and stops the sequence.
